items.text: Deloken, karpèt sing ayu ngene dikencingi taik.
items.q: Is 'dikencingi taik' a natural way to say he defecated on the carpet?
before: …nahan luwih saka telung taun, dina kuwi tiba luwih kenceng ing rainé Eskandar. Nalika mlayu, sikilé Farid ngidak bukuné Eskandar, sampul korané suwèk. Pojok judhul dawa bukuné katon: "Sepuluh Èwu ... Kaéraman, Ngerti ... Af... Kanggo ...". Rong telung bengi Farid ora bali kamar. Eskandar kandha:

– Kadal cilik kuwi nglanggar hukum fisika uga. Mlayu luwih cepet saka cahya, yèn ora, tak gantung saka bokongé. Ya wis, kandhaa, bajingan bodho, nèk kowe ora mikir irungku, paling ora mikir karpèt sing ayu ngene.

items.q: Maman quotes a lonely friend who has nothing to do all day. A Persian saying kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Nalika ngguyu, Hooman napuk gegerku kenceng lan gula watu kuwi mencolot menyang gorokanku.
items.q: Hooman thumps Amir on the back while he drinks tea. A Persian image kept word for word: can you guess what happens?

items.text: Aja kandha marang Eskandar sing nyebahi kuwi, mengko lungguh sak jam menehi kita pitutur, mangananku dadi kaya racun ula.
items.q: A student got a big portion of rice and fears a friend's lecture. A Persian expression kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Taghi wis nyolong lima tomat saka toko woh-wohane Amu Badiollah. Siji wis dipangan, lan sisané dibuwang ing tengah dalan.
items.q: Is it clear Taghi ate one tomato and the boys threw the rest?
before: – Tegesé luwih sugih tinimbang kancané sedulur misané ...

items.text: Aku lagi ngerti sawisé kulawargaku meksa aku kecampur karo pitik-pitik, jagad sisih kono kuwi jagad sing beda banget.
items.q: A friend talks about his own life after his family pushed him. A Persian expression kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Maman, isih separo ngantuk, kandha marang kita, kandhaa waé marang dhèwèké: waca waé meteranmu terus lungaa, apa urusanmu nganggo pira dhuwité kita?
items.q: Is it clear Maman means how much electricity they used?
before: – Lucu banget. Oh iya, rong telung minggu kepungkur, wektu petugas listrik teka arep maca meteran, Baba mangkat mbukak lawang, swarané petugas kuwi keprungu, kandha: penggunaanipun kathah, Haaj Agha.

items.text: Pratingkah nasibipun jaman kados mekaten menika ingkang taksih ndamel kula gadhah pangajeng-ajeng dhateng masa depan.
items.q: Is it clear the speaker means the games fate plays?
before: – Menarik, menarik sanget. Wonten tiyang Iran ingkang mriki nyambut damel ing papan ingkang rumiyin nate dados pusat panaliten nuklir.
